title: A Vibe written yesterday, anchored on one film, with no verdict anywhere
catches: The P5 regression: a declaration ignored because nothing under it is loved. This model contains no verdicts at all, so a recommendation that does not use the Vibe has used nothing.
construction_note: M5 (D11): a Vibe can no longer be written with no film under it — every new Vibe is anchored on a core. Re-expressed as a Vibe whose only film is its core, seen, with no verdict anywhere, which keeps the point: nothing under it is loved, and the Vibe still has to be used.

genres.instruction: I want to come out knowing a person, not a plot.
